description: Negash, Araya and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The configured example combines HYDRUS unsaturated-zone transport with MODFLOW6 aquifer transport to estimate concentrations at a drinking-water abstraction compliance point. It uses PFOA-contaminated soil or dredged material to derive corresponding soil or sediment risk limits. The source gives both a volume of fifty cubic metres and dimensions of seven by seven by one metre; that small numerical inconsistency is preserved. The example concentration is seven micrograms per kilogram. These are scenario assumptions and model inputs, not a verified contaminated-site survey or current regulatory limit. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
